artifact_templates.name: Shelter Founding Charter
artifact_templates.default_origin: Signed by the original shelter pioneers during the first ashfall.
artifact_templates.description: Faded parchment setting forth the governance and survival covenant.

artifact_templates.name: First Geiger Counter
artifact_templates.default_origin: Used to verify safe radiation levels before sealing the blast doors.
artifact_templates.description: Analog radiation detector preserved in a sealed glass case.

artifact_templates.name: Commander's Service Sidearm
artifact_templates.default_origin: Recovered from the final defense of the primary intake gate.
artifact_templates.description: Decommissioned pre-war service pistol with ceremonial engravings.

artifact_templates.name: First Winter Medical Journal
artifact_templates.default_origin: Authored by Chief Medic Vance during the great quarantine.
artifact_templates.description: Handwritten clinical records tracking the first containment victories.

artifact_templates.name: Irradiated Karst Geode
artifact_templates.default_origin: Excavated from the deep sub-basement bedrock expansion.
artifact_templates.description: A mineral formation shimmering with faint luminescent crystals.

artifact_templates.name: First Warden Heavy Greatcoat
artifact_templates.default_origin: Worn by the first shelter supervisor during the surface evacuation.
artifact_templates.description: Reinforced wool trench coat bearing the original sector insignia.
